source_locations.text: Reference XObject concept; containing/target document; proxy; two processor behaviors; embedded/external target possibility; Table 95 /F and /Page.
Table 95 /ID; imported-page transformation, clipping, proxy Group.

features.feature: Recognize Ref on Form XObject and proxy fallback
features.norm: Ref presence distinguishes reference XObjects. Processor not recognizing Ref displays/prints proxy as an ordinary Form XObject; implementing processor uses proxy when imported content is unavailable. Proxy should be processed when target unavailable.
features.implementation: Form XObject dispatch reads /Ref; `Supply::NONE` draws proxy without report; supplied target import replaces proxy; unavailable/identified mismatch/page-not-found paths draw proxy and report when supply existed.
features.assertions: `reference_xobjects.rs` has exact-color proxy vs no-Ref control, imported page color, unavailable target/changed ID/missing page/no ID outcomes. Direct model tests; no current public host print seam test.

features.norm: Table 95 /F is required and identifies the PDF file. /ID is optional; it is a two-byte-string array that improves locating intended file and permits warning on change. §14.4 explains matching both identifiers means very likely correct/unchanged; matching first only means a different version of the correct file.
features.implementation: `Reference::read` parses and retains FileSpec, Page, optional ID. `Supply::find` never consults FileSpec; it requires ID, scans candidates for the first permanent-ID match, then compares changing ID only on that first match. `Supply::read` rejects every target with no trailer ID, although a PDF 1.7 target may omit it.
features.assertions: Existing tests cover a single target exact ID, a changed second string, wrong first ID, missing reference ID, and target without ID; no collision/multiple-candidate precedence test or no-ID F-name resolution test.

features.norm: Required /Page is integer page index or text page label (§12.4.2); may become invalid if target page replaced.
features.implementation: Integer is zero-based index; text is decoded and compared against computed page labels, but search is capped at 4096 indices. A present label at index 4096 or later is reported as a nonexistent page rather than a resource-limit case.
features.assertions: `form_xobjects_audit.rs` tests a label selecting the blue second page, an integer-zero control selecting green first page, missing-label proxy fallback, exact xref for containing fixture. It is outside the reference_xobjects.rs suite but does test public model interpretation. Draft boundary test covers index4095/4096 label and numeric controls.

features.norm: Imported page uses proxy Form Matrix and BBox. Proxy Group attributes apply to imported page.
features.implementation: Imported page receives transformed graphics state and BBox clip; proxy group enters around imported page.
features.assertions: `reference_xobjects.rs` asserts pixels inside/outside BBox, same-number resource separation, and proxy group behavior. ADR 1339 addresses nesting with target page group. Not re-audited in depth.

features.norm: Target may reside in external file or be embedded file stream. Table95 /F is required. Target availability is conditional for proxy fallback.
features.implementation: Host reads a user-selected directory into `ReferenceFiles`; all offered PDFs are parsed as a supply. No path is opened by renderer. Embedded files in containing PDF are not automatically added to Supply; absent IDs are refused before matching.
features.assertions: No imported-target fixture covers embedded target or an ID-less PDF selected by an explicitly supplied /F name. These are unresolved source/policy boundaries, not automatically conformance failures.

source_locations.text: Printer may emit imported content or proxy depending on capabilities, preferences, and job.

features.norm: Permission: a processor may emit imported content or the proxy according to its capabilities/preferences/job; this is not a mandatory imported-over-proxy choice.
features.implementation: PrintPage calls same `open::interpret` with the open reference supply, so it chooses imported content when supplied and proxy otherwise.
features.assertions: Ledger cites generic `a_printed_page_is_targeted_at_the_jobs_resolution`, which does not contain a Ref. Core print shares the interpreter, but no public Viewer test checks ReferenceFiles→Print→printed pixels against supplied/unsupplied controls.

source_locations.text: Printable, unhidden, visible annotation APs included; snapshot producers include APs; logical structure may be ignored with rationale/one-page caveat.

features.norm: All annotations with printable, unhidden, visible appearance stream shall be in rendering of imported page. Snapshot proxy writers shall include those APs in proxy stream (producer requirement).
features.implementation: Imported page runs target document annotation pass under target document state; imported-page clipping covers annotations. Snapshot-proxy synthesis is not this viewer's reader behavior.
features.assertions: Existing test asserts a printable, visible Square AP appears and is clipped with page; it does not provide negative-flag controls for hidden/nonprintable/NoView across screen vs print intent.

features.norm: May be ignored when importing; in some one-page or independent-page documents it may be possible to incorporate it.
features.implementation: Imported page is interpreted with an empty parent tree; structure is ignored.
features.assertions: No dedicated structure inclusion/ignore comparison found; omission is an allowed choice, not a defect.

errata: No EC3 annotation affecting §§8.10.4.1–.3 was found in doc/errata-read.md or the source-page annotation overlay. Effective text is as cited above.
